final_assessment: Captured what the sixth proposal pass taught, and ACTED on it rather than walking it. R-crc-8 records the trap the session nearly fell into: finding quality never licenses another pass, because a walk that authors guarantees the next pass finds real defects, so a program asking only whether reviews find real defects never stops. Its corollary makes the redesign-lane trigger SECTIONAL and per-requirement — a change-level concentration figure cannot see one clause generating every CRITICAL while the rest converges, which is exactly what happened (clause (b) took four CRITICALs and converged; clause (c) took five and did not). R-crc-7 gained the blanket-default corollary: a convention that defaults unstated empty cases is not a specification, since two of rc02's three defaulted cases were harmless and the third was the canonical happy path. Three charters gained evidence: rc04 measures concentration per requirement, rc03 gains the zero-findings-is-legitimate prompt line with the control showing it suppresses nothing, rc13's evidence base is now six passes and 72 findings. The act: clause (c) LEFT rc02 for the new stage rc02c-confirmation-semantics, which will specify it as a decision table under R-crc-7 with three measured problems as its premise; rc02 ships the shipped predicate unchanged, which on the trail that exposed rc02's worst defect is strictly stronger than the rewrite it was carrying. Fourteen stages.
